note: A synthetic credit policy written to match the demonstration books. It is modelled on Saudi retail and corporate practice and on SAMA's published rules, and it is NOT any institution's actual policy. Clause numbers, thresholds, owners and review dates are authored for this product.

retail.title: Retail Credit Policy
retail.scope: All consumer lending: mortgage, personal finance, auto finance, credit cards and buy now pay later.

clauses.title: Debt burden ratio caps
clauses.rule: Total monthly credit obligations may not exceed the debt burden ratio (DBR) cap for the customer's employment type, measured on verified income.

clauses.title: Salary transfer
clauses.rule: Unsecured lending above SAR 0.15 million to a salaried customer requires salary transfer to the bank. Without transfer, the exposure limit is halved and the DBR cap falls by 10 percentage points.
levers: make salary transfer mandatory for a segment

clauses.title: Non-salaried income assessment
clauses.rule: Non-salaried applicants require twelve months of bank statements, and assessed income is the lower of the declared figure and the trailing twelve-month average of credited inflows discounted by 20%.

sections.title: Product limits, tenor and score cut-offs

clauses.title: Credit card limits by sub-product
clauses.rule: Approved card limits may not exceed the sub-product ceiling, and may not exceed four times verified net monthly income.

clauses.title: Behavioural score cut-offs at origination
clauses.rule: Minimum application score by product: Mortgage 620, Auto Finance 600, Personal Finance 620, Credit Card 640, Buy Now Pay Later 660. Non-salaried applicants carry a +40 point uplift on the applicable cut-off.
levers: withdraw a product from a segment

clauses.title: Maximum tenor
clauses.rule: Mortgage 300 months; Auto Finance 60 months; Personal Finance 60 months; Buy Now Pay Later 6 months. Tenor may not extend beyond the customer's 65th birthday for salaried applicants or 60th for non-salaried.

clauses.title: Loan to value on secured retail lending
clauses.rule: Mortgage LTV may not exceed 85% for a first home and 70% otherwise. Auto Finance LTV may not exceed 80% for a new vehicle and 65% for a used one. An account whose LTV rises above its cap by more than 5 percentage points is reported to the Retail Credit Committee.

clauses.title: Override authority
clauses.rule: A policy override requires the approval of one authority level above the normal approver, must state the compensating factor, and may not breach RP-1.1 or RP-2.4. Overrides may not exceed 5% of monthly originations by count for any product.
levers: withdraw override authority for a product

clauses.title: Pilot phase for a new product
clauses.rule: A product with no through-cycle performance history is written under a pilot mandate for its first four quarters: a portfolio ceiling of 3% of retail exposure, monthly vintage reporting to the Retail Credit Committee, and cut-offs set one band tighter than the nearest comparable product.

clauses.title: Partner and digital origination
clauses.rule: Accounts written through a partner channel are subject to the same cut-offs as branch origination and to a monthly first-payment-default review. A partner whose three-month first-payment-default rate exceeds 2.5% is suspended pending review.

clauses.title: Vintage monitoring
clauses.rule: Every origination vintage is tracked to 12 months on book. A vintage whose 30+ delinquency at 6-9 months on book exceeds the trailing four-vintage average by more than 50% triggers a cut-off review within one month.
levers: review the cut-offs in force at that vintage

clauses.title: Collections actions by arrears band
clauses.rule: Contact intensity follows the arrears band, measured on days past due.

thresholds.1-9: automated reminder (SMS and app notification) on day 3 and day 7
thresholds.10-19: outbound call from the contact centre within 48 hours
thresholds.20-29: field visit or a supervised restructure offer; the account is flagged for the pre-delinquency review
thresholds.30-59: formal demand notice; limit frozen; no further drawdown
thresholds.60-89: transfer to specialist collections; settlement authority delegated
thresholds.90-179: legal referral and provisioning at lifetime ECL

levers: move an action earlier in the arrears curve

clauses.title: Restructure eligibility
clauses.rule: An account may be restructured once in any twelve-month period, only where the cause of arrears is documented and temporary, and only where the restructured obligation satisfies RP-1.1. A restructured account is held in Stage 2 for a minimum of twelve months.

clauses.title: Seasonal payment deferral
clauses.rule: A deferral of up to one instalment may be granted in Ramadan and the following month on request, once per customer per year, for accounts current at the point of request. A deferral granted under this clause does not count as forbearance and does not trigger SICR.

clauses.title: Write-off
clauses.rule: An unsecured retail exposure is written off at 210 days past due. A secured exposure is written off on completion of recovery action or at 360 days past due, whichever is earlier. Write-off does not extinguish the claim.

clauses.title: Significant increase in credit risk
clauses.rule: An account moves to Stage 2 on any of: 30 days past due; a behavioural score below 520; a fall of more than 105 points from the score at origination; or a restructure under RP-4.2.

clauses.title: Default
clauses.rule: Default is recognised at 90 days past due or on an unlikeliness-to-pay assessment, whichever is earlier. A defaulted account returns to Stage 2 only after twelve consecutive months of performance.

corporate.title: Corporate Credit Policy
corporate.scope: All corporate and commercial lending: term loans, working capital, revolving credit, trade finance, project finance, overdrafts, asset finance and supply chain finance.

clauses.title: Single obligor limit
clauses.rule: Total exposure to a single obligor may not exceed SAR 25,000 million. Exposure is measured as EAD, funded and unfunded together.

clauses.title: Connected group limit
clauses.rule: Total exposure to a group of connected obligors may not exceed SAR 50,000 million. Connection is by ownership or by control, not by sector. Group exposure is reported to the Board Credit Committee every quarter and on any breach.
levers: freeze new facilities to the group

clauses.title: Sector concentration
clauses.rule: Exposure to any one sector may not exceed 18% of the corporate book, and to any one sub-sector 7%. A sector above its limit is closed to new names until it is within it.
levers: close a sector to new names

clauses.title: Standard covenant package
clauses.rule: Every term facility carries a debt service coverage covenant at a minimum of 1.20x, a leverage covenant at a maximum of 4.0x net debt to EBITDA, and an interest cover covenant at a minimum of 2.50x, tested quarterly on management accounts and annually on audited accounts.
levers: raise the DSCR floor for a sub-sector

clauses.title: Breach and waiver
clauses.rule: A covenant breach is reported within five business days. A waiver requires the approval of the sanctioning authority, may not be granted twice consecutively for the same covenant, and must be accompanied by a remediation plan. Two consecutive breaches move the obligor to the watchlist under CP-3.1.

clauses.title: Debt service below policy
clauses.rule: An obligor whose DSCR falls below 1.20x is placed on the watchlist irrespective of its internal rating. An obligor below 1.00x is reviewed for unlikeliness to pay within one quarter.

clauses.title: Watchlist
clauses.rule: An obligor is placed on the watchlist on any of: a fall of two or more notches from the rating at origination; an internal grade at or below CCC; a DSCR below 1.20x; or two consecutive covenant breaches. Watchlist names are reviewed monthly.
levers: shorten the review cycle for a sub-sector

clauses.title: Rating review frequency
clauses.rule: Internal ratings are reviewed annually, and within one quarter of a covenant breach, a two-notch fall in debt service coverage, or a material adverse event. A sub-sector whose average DSCR falls by more than 0.25x in two quarters is reviewed as a portfolio.
levers: order an out-of-cycle sub-sector rating review
suspend new lending to a sub-sector

clauses.title: Significant increase in credit risk
clauses.rule: A facility moves to Stage 2 on any of: 30 days past due; an internal grade at or below CCC; or a fall of two or more notches from the rating at origination. Default is recognised at 90 days past due or at an internal grade at or below CC.

clauses.title: Collateral haircuts
clauses.rule: Recognised collateral value is market value less the haircut for its type: cash deposit 0%, real estate 30%, plant and equipment 45%, receivables 50%, corporate guarantee 60%. Receivables are recognised only where assigned and notified.

clauses.title: Revaluation and LTV
clauses.rule: Real estate security is revalued every 24 months, and every 12 months where the facility is on the watchlist. A facility whose LTV after haircut exceeds 100% must be topped up or amortised within two quarters.

clauses.title: Product approval and pilot limits
clauses.rule: A new corporate product requires Board Credit Committee approval and is written under a pilot mandate for its first four quarters: a portfolio ceiling of 4% of corporate exposure, quarterly performance reporting by origination vintage, and no override authority below the Chief Credit Officer.

clauses.title: Supply chain and receivables finance
clauses.rule: Supply chain finance is underwritten against the anchor obligor, not the supplier, and is subject to the anchor's single obligor limit under CP-1.1. Programme limits are reviewed quarterly, and dilution above 5% of assigned receivables suspends new drawdowns.
